newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway t-bill expansion gets 4.02 pct high yield.
newsitem.headline: Norway t-bill expansion gets 4.02 pct high yield.

text.p: Norway's central bank said on Monday that a five billion crown expansion of Treasury bill SS45 produced a highest yield of 4.02 percent.
The lowest yield was 3.96 percent and the weighted average rate was 4.00 percent. Bids for the highest accepted rate had a 61.3 percent allotment.
The bill matures on Dec. 17 this year.
It was issued last month with five billion crowns going to the market and 500 million crowns reserved for the central bank. It has a nominal interest rate of 4.30 percent.
